messages:
Priya (People Ops): FYI — Evelyn's adoption finalized today and she missed open enrollment. She needs the child added retroactively. @Liam - Benefits, can we do a retroactive dependent add for an adoption? What docs/timeline do we need? :wave:
PeopleOps Bot: New case created: #7892 — adoption retroactive coverage request (Evelyn Chen). Logged by Priya.
Liam - Benefits: Hi all — short answer: yes, we typically allow retroactive enrollment for adoptions, but there are doc + timing rules. For adoptions we need the adoption decree OR court finalization paperwork and proof of placement. Enrollment request should be submitted within 30 days of finalization to be effective as of the finalization/placement date.
Evelyn Chen: Thanks — finalization date is 2026-02-28. I'm still waiting on the child's SSN (applying). Can I still enroll now? Also, I have some medical bills from March that I hoped would be covered.
Liam - Benefits: You can initiate enrollment without SSN (mark as pending), but we need the SSN within 60 days of enrollment for dependent verification and claims. If SSN isn't provided in time, claims may be delayed. Medical expenses incurred after the effective date are typically eligible once dependent is added. Payroll will do a retro premium adjustment back to 2026-02-28. Please submit: 1) completed Dependent Addition form (link: https://intranet.redwood/benefits/forms), 2) adoption decree or placement docs, 3) SSN when available. Email benefits@redwood.com and cc Priya.
Samir Patel: If the request crosses the 30-day window, is an exception route available? Do we need director approval? Also flagging Finance for any payroll retro adjustments.
Priya (People Ops): If docs come in after 30 days we'll escalate to Director (People Ops) for exception — can take a few business days. Evelyn, DM me the scanned decree and placement docs and I'll open the formal request with benefits and payroll today. :thumbsup:
PeopleOps Bot: Case #7892 assigned to Liam - Benefits. Reminder: provisional deadline to submit SSN for dependent verification: 2026-04-28.
Evelyn Chen: Will do — sending DM now. Appreciate the quick answers.
Liam - Benefits: Thanks — once we have the decree and the form we'll backdate coverage to 2026-02-28 and process any eligible claims. For FSA/Dependent Care: dependent care reimbursements require SSN before claims are paid out, medical FSAs can be eligible if expense after effective date. Reach out if anything missing.
